businesses.business: Contract manufacturing of medical devices, packaging and components

offering_description.value: The company develops and manufactures single-use and single-patient medical devices, components and sterile packaging for medical device manufacturers. It also makes custom components and packaging for aerospace, defense, automotive and other customers. It works with customers from design and prototyping through full-scale production, using foams, films, plastics, fabrics and other specialty materials.

quotes.quote: UFP Technologies is the trusted design, development, engineering, and manufacturing partner to turn your vision into a reality through best-in-class comprehensive solutions primarily for medical devices and sterile packaging, as well as other highly engineered custom products.

and headquartered in Newburyport, Massachusetts, UFP Technologies is a contract development and manufacturing organization that specializes in single-use and single-patient medical devices. UFP is an important link in the medical device supply chain and a valued outsource partner to many of the top medical device manufacturers in the world. Our single-use and single-patient devices and components are used in a wide range of medical devices and packaging for minimally invasive surgery, infection prevention, wound care, wearables, orthopedic soft goods, and orthopedic implants.
